title: Chapter 342: The First Floor Of Shura Tower
content:
Chapter 342: The First Floor Of Shura Tower

"Lord, you are right. I am not as good as you."

Chang Gui's wooden head turned around, as if it was out of control.

"The boss is right. Even if you are sure of success, you may still fail. On the contrary, if you know that something is impossible, do we give up?"

"What a bullshit fate. If you don't push yourself, you may never know that you are so good!"

Seeing that everyone is so determined, Wang Shuo was deeply moved.

So many days have passed. Except for those who are very lucky, those who can survive until now are basically resolute and courageous.

Wang Shuo told a few people about the Shura War Tower.

Tell them to keep it secret. If someone really asks, just claim that you are going to explore the secret realm!

When he is not in the territory, Duan Wenxi decides on internal affairs and Ayub is in charge of military affairs.

He also handed over another legion order to Ayub and asked him to start forming the second legion in the territory.

"After I leave, gather our main forces to Wana County. At the critical moment, we can give up Nanshanji and Changping County. If we encounter an unexpected accident, we can ask Zhao Junshou for help."

"Yes, Lord (Boss)!"

After arranging the affairs of the territory, Wang Shuo fasted and bathed, and thought about every aspect of the whole thing several times.

The next morning, he came to the back garden, fed the koi, and collected the water of life.

He went to the material exchange office in the central square, exchanged some tools, and transferred the authority to Duan Wenxi.

Wang Shuo called Duan Wenxi and Ayub to the Lord's Mansion, and then prepared to enter the Shura War General Tower.

Take out the invitation letter and choose to use it.

The system prompt sounded.

[Warning: You are about to leave Dahuai Territory! ]

[Warning: You are about to leave Dahuai Territory! ]

...

The alarm sounded.

The voice of Lord Zak sounded in his mind.

"Little guy, are you ready? Entering there is a life-or-death situation!"

Wang Shuo took a deep breath and said in a deep voice: "Ready!"

In the unknown space, Lord Zack nodded and showed an approving look.

"Okay, in that case, I'll take you there!"

In the hall of the Lord's Mansion, many supplies prepared by Wang Shuo were scattered all over the ground.

I don't know how long it took, Wang Shuo woke up in a strange square with a dizzy head.

The white jade square is not big, only more than ten square meters, surrounded by a white energy shield.

One of the white round stone pillars is particularly conspicuous.

After Wang Shuo touched it with his hand, a lot of information immediately appeared in his mind.

I understand that this place is a small safe zone in the wild.

Newcomers who have just entered usually appear in this kind of safe zone.

Fighting is strictly prohibited within the white energy shield, otherwise both parties will be attacked by the energy shield.

There are four floors in Shura Tower. This is the first floor of Shura Tower. In the first floor, there is also a neutral town called Yingying Town, where fighting is also not allowed.

There is only one way to enter the second floor.

That is to collect 100 Shura Orders, and then summon the passage to pass through the level. As long as you defeat the guards guarding the passage, you can enter the second floor.

As for the 99 Shura Orders, they will naturally be snatched from other people.

Here, it can be said that any creature is your enemy.

Wang Shuo immediately opened his backpack and found a token with the three words "Shura Order" written on it.
